english.meaning: 6:45; in telling the time, 九 stands for 45 minutes
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Yeah, he’s picking up the bride at seven. I have to get up after five and get to his place before 6:09.
exampleSentences.traditional: 係啊，佢七點鐘接新娘，我五點幾要起身，跟住六點九之前要去到佢度嚹。
